blocks.content: A dashboard is a saved page of panels. You'll open the dashboard of a demo wind farm on Grafana Play, meet the panels that watch its power and wind, then change the time window and watch every panel follow.
To open a dashboard, complete the following steps:
Click **Dashboards** in the main menu. This page lists every saved dashboard, grouped in folders.
Open **Demo Wind Farm**, one of the dashboards in the **Examples** folder. It watches a small wind farm: power produced, turbine speed, and wind.
You opened a saved dashboard from the dashboard list. No setup, just a click.
Next, read the dashboard and try its controls:

blocks.reftarget: [data-testid='data-testid Panel header Wind Farm - Total Average Power (Watts)']
blocks.content: Each rectangle is a **panel**: one view of the data. This chart tracks the farm's power output over time. Others on the page show single numbers, like **Current Power**.
blocks.tooltip: One view of the data. A dashboard is a saved page of these.

blocks.content: Every panel hides its own menu. Hover over **Current Power** to reveal it.

steps.tooltip: Hover here and a menu fades in at the corner, with **View**, **Share**, and **Inspect** for a closer look.

blocks.content: Click the **time range** at the top right. It sets the window of time the whole page shows.
blocks.tooltip: The window of time the whole page is showing. Every panel follows it.

blocks.reftarget: [data-testid='data-testid TimePicker time range option now-1h to now'] label
blocks.content: Choose **Last 1 hour** and watch: every panel on the page redraws to the new window at once.
blocks.tooltip: One change here re-asks every question on the page for the new window of time.

blocks.content: **What you have learned:** Panels show the data, each panel hides a menu for a closer look, and the time range sets the window for the whole page. Change it once and every panel follows. That's enough to read almost any dashboard you meet.
